title: Pick an output format
intro: A CI job runs Claude Code with -p. Pick the output format and see what the script receives.

show.title: Plain text
show.detail: The default. Only Claude's final answer is printed, ready to show in a log.

trace.text: Prints the answer as text and exits with code 0.

show.title: One JSON object
show.detail: The output is a single JSON object with the result, the session id and run details, so a script can read fields with a tool such as jq.

show.title: A stream of events
show.detail: Each event is printed as its own JSON line while Claude works. Streaming needs --verbose as well.

trace.text: Prints one JSON event per line until the run ends.

quiz.question: Which flag lets a headless run use some tools without asking?
quiz.explanation: --allowedTools pre-approves tools using permission rule syntax, such as "Read,Edit,Bash(git diff *)".
